# Marketing Report

`marketing-report` · v1.0.0 · Execute · Analytics & Experimentation
<!-- Generated by platform/scripts/generate-engine-specs.mjs from skills/marketing-report/spec.json and SKILL.md. Do not edit. -->

**Decision it supports:** How did marketing perform this period against target and the prior period, and where is the funnel leaking?

**Inputs:** One period of spend, funnel volumes (sessions, leads, MQLs, SQLs, opps, wins — any subset), new revenue, pipeline created, and target; plus the prior period for deltas

**Output:** A full-funnel KPI snapshot (stage conversion, CAC, cost per lead, new-revenue-to-spend, pipeline-to-spend, target attainment), period-over-period deltas, and a board-ready narrative structure

**Setup:**
- Install the skill: `npx skills add sarojkjha/aaj-marketing-skills --skill marketing-report`
- Or connect the hosted MCP server, no install: `https://aaj-engines-mcp.sarojkjha10.workers.dev/mcp`
- Or run the local MCP server: node platform/mcp/server.mjs (Node 18 or newer)
- Input schema: the comment at the top of `skills/marketing-report/resources/marketing-report.js` (the MCP server's describe_engine shows it). Worked example: `node skills/marketing-report/resources/marketing-report.js --demo`.
- Agents listed: Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, Windsurf, Cline. Tested and recorded: not recorded yet.

**Acts or analyzes:** Analyzes only. The engine makes no network calls, writes no files and changes nothing in your tools; it returns text and JSON.

**Where your information goes:**

| How you run it | Where your inputs go |
|---|---|
| Skill installed in your agent, or the local MCP server | The engine runs on your machine and AAJ receives nothing. Your AI agent still sends what you give it to its model provider (Anthropic, OpenAI and so on), under your own account's terms. |
| Hosted MCP server | Your agent's model provider, as above, plus AAJ's server on Cloudflare, which receives the engine inputs over HTTPS, runs them in memory and keeps no copy. Cloudflare keeps error logs (no inputs) for up to 7 days. |

No engine needs customer names, emails or other personal data; leave them out.

**Limitations:**
- CAC is total spend over total wins, a blended figure that flatters paid channels. Use channel-level numbers for channel decisions and say which you used.
- Every ratio uses same-period numbers. New revenue : spend is an efficiency read, not ROI; with a long sales cycle, this period's wins came from earlier spend and leads.
- A field it doesn't recognise ("MQLs" for "mqls") is dropped without warning and the stage rate is computed across the gap. Input it doesn't recognise gives an empty report, not an error; check the result reflects your numbers.
- Deltas assume the prior period used the same definitions and windows. The engine cannot check that.

**Review before acting:** The marketing lead or RevOps owner confirms the stage definitions and spend basis match the prior period, and states whether CAC is blended or by channel, before the report goes to the board.

Method: [skills.aajconsult.com/skills/marketing-report](https://skills.aajconsult.com/skills/marketing-report)
